phases.title: Phase 1: 7-Day Kickstart
phases.subtitle: Building daily awareness and starting with simple, high-impact habits

tasks.title: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
tasks.instruction: Enjoy a comfortable 20-minute brisk walk after lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking at a pace where you can talk comfortably.
tasks.why_selected: Regular daily walking helps your muscles absorb blood sugar directly.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning
tasks.instruction: Use the plate method: 1/2 vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 whole grains.
tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: 15-Minute Movement Session
tasks.instruction: Take a 15-minute active break with bodyweight movement or brisk walking.
tasks.suggestion: Light dynamic stretches, stairs, or indoor walking.
tasks.why_selected: Short movement breaks improve insulin response throughout the day.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 30-Minute Aerobic Activity
tasks.instruction: Complete a 30-minute session of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking, stationary cycling, or swimming.
tasks.why_selected: Contributes to your weekly 150–300 minute aerobic target.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time

tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Post-Meal Digestive Walk
tasks.instruction: Take a gentle 15-minute stroll within 30 minutes after your largest meal.
tasks.suggestion: Gentle outdoor or treadmill walking.
tasks.why_selected: Post-meal walking significantly blunts blood sugar spikes.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: Weekend Active Recreation
tasks.instruction: Engage in 30–45 minutes of enjoyable active leisure.
tasks.suggestion: Park walk, gardening, hiking, or recreational cycling.
tasks.why_selected: Builds long-term enjoyment and consistency in regular movement.

tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 30-Minute Aerobic Activity
tasks.instruction: Complete a 30-minute session of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking, stationary cycling, or swimming.
tasks.why_selected: Contributes to your weekly 150–300 minute aerobic target.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Post-Meal Digestive Walk
tasks.instruction: Take a gentle 15-minute stroll within 30 minutes after your largest meal.
tasks.suggestion: Gentle outdoor or treadmill walking.
tasks.why_selected: Post-meal walking significantly blunts blood sugar spikes.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Weekend Active Recreation

tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: 15-Minute Movement Session
tasks.instruction: Take a 15-minute active break with bodyweight movement or brisk walking.
tasks.suggestion: Light dynamic stretches, stairs, or indoor walking.
tasks.why_selected: Short movement breaks improve insulin response throughout the day.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 30-Minute Aerobic Activity
tasks.instruction: Complete a 30-minute session of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking, stationary cycling, or swimming.
tasks.why_selected: Contributes to your weekly 150–300 minute aerobic target.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.

phases.title: Phase 1: 7-Day Kickstart
phases.subtitle: Building daily awareness and starting with simple, high-impact habits

tasks.title: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
tasks.instruction: Enjoy a comfortable 20-minute brisk walk after lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking at a pace where you can talk comfortably.
tasks.why_selected: Regular daily walking helps your muscles absorb blood sugar directly.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: 15-Minute Movement Session
tasks.instruction: Take a 15-minute active break with bodyweight movement or brisk walking.
tasks.suggestion: Light dynamic stretches, stairs, or indoor walking.
tasks.why_selected: Short movement breaks improve insulin response throughout the day.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 30-Minute Aerobic Activity
tasks.instruction: Complete a 30-minute session of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking, stationary cycling, or swimming.
tasks.why_selected: Contributes to your weekly 150–300 minute aerobic target.

tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning
tasks.instruction: Use the plate method: 1/2 vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 whole grains.
tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: Weekend Active Recreation
tasks.instruction: Engage in 30–45 minutes of enjoyable active leisure.
tasks.suggestion: Park walk, gardening, hiking, or recreational cycling.
tasks.why_selected: Builds long-term enjoyment and consistency in regular movement.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Weekly Movement Summary Check
tasks.instruction: Review your weekly physical activity and aim for a gentle 20-minute stroll.
tasks.suggestion: Check if you reached your weekly movement goals.
tasks.why_selected: Tracking consistency builds confidence in long-term habit formation.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.

tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 30-Minute Aerobic Activity
tasks.instruction: Complete a 30-minute session of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking, stationary cycling, or swimming.
tasks.why_selected: Contributes to your weekly 150–300 minute aerobic target.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Post-Meal Digestive Walk
tasks.instruction: Take a gentle 15-minute stroll within 30 minutes after your largest meal.
tasks.suggestion: Gentle outdoor or treadmill walking.
tasks.why_selected: Post-meal walking significantly blunts blood sugar spikes.

tasks.suggestion: Check if you reached your weekly movement goals.
tasks.why_selected: Tracking consistency builds confidence in long-term habit formation.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
tasks.instruction: Enjoy a comfortable 20-minute brisk walk after lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking at a pace where you can talk comfortably.
tasks.why_selected: Regular daily walking helps your muscles absorb blood sugar directly.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning
tasks.instruction: Use the plate method: 1/2 vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 whole grains.
tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Post-Meal Digestive Walk
tasks.instruction: Take a gentle 15-minute stroll within 30 minutes after your largest meal.
tasks.suggestion: Gentle outdoor or treadmill walking.
tasks.why_selected: Post-meal walking significantly blunts blood sugar spikes.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning
tasks.instruction: Use the plate method: 1/2 vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 whole grains.
tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
tasks.instruction: Enjoy a comfortable 20-minute brisk walk after lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking at a pace where you can talk comfortably.
tasks.why_selected: Regular daily walking helps your muscles absorb blood sugar directly.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: 15-Minute Movement Session

tasks.title: Post-Meal Digestive Walk

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning

tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine

tasks.title: Weekend Active Recreation

tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Weekly Movement Summary Check
tasks.instruction: Review your weekly physical activity and aim for a gentle 20-minute stroll.
tasks.suggestion: Check if you reached your weekly movement goals.
tasks.why_selected: Tracking consistency builds confidence in long-term habit formation.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
tasks.instruction: Enjoy a comfortable 20-minute brisk walk after lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking at a pace where you can talk comfortably.
tasks.why_selected: Regular daily walking helps your muscles absorb blood sugar directly.

tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Weekly Movement Summary Check
tasks.instruction: Review your weekly physical activity and aim for a gentle 20-minute stroll.
tasks.suggestion: Check if you reached your weekly movement goals.
tasks.why_selected: Tracking consistency builds confidence in long-term habit formation.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
tasks.instruction: Enjoy a comfortable 20-minute brisk walk after lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Brisk walking at a pace where you can talk comfortably.
tasks.why_selected: Regular daily walking helps your muscles absorb blood sugar directly.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain

tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Post-Meal Digestive Walk
tasks.instruction: Take a gentle 15-minute stroll within 30 minutes after your largest meal.
tasks.suggestion: Gentle outdoor or treadmill walking.
tasks.why_selected: Post-meal walking significantly blunts blood sugar spikes.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Include 2 Servings of Colourful Vegetables
tasks.instruction: Fill at least half your lunch or dinner plate with non-starchy vegetables.
tasks.suggestion: Broccoli, spinach, carrots, bell peppers, or salad greens.
tasks.why_selected: Non-starchy vegetables provide high nutrient density with minimal caloric impact.

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning
tasks.instruction: Use the plate method: 1/2 vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 whole grains.
tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: Weekend Active Recreation
tasks.instruction: Engage in 30–45 minutes of enjoyable active leisure.
tasks.suggestion: Park walk, gardening, hiking, or recreational cycling.
tasks.why_selected: Builds long-term enjoyment and consistency in regular movement.

tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Mindful Plate Portioning
tasks.instruction: Use the plate method: 1/2 vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 whole grains.
tasks.suggestion: Visual portion control without complicated calorie counting.
tasks.why_selected: Supports a gradual, sustainable 500–750 kcal daily caloric reduction.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.

tasks.title: Weekend Active Recreation
tasks.instruction: Engage in 30–45 minutes of enjoyable active leisure.
tasks.suggestion: Park walk, gardening, hiking, or recreational cycling.
tasks.why_selected: Builds long-term enjoyment and consistency in regular movement.

tasks.title: Add Healthy Seeds or Nuts
tasks.instruction: Sprinkle a spoonful of nuts or seeds over your meal or breakfast.
tasks.suggestion: Chia seeds, ground flaxseeds, walnuts, or almonds.
tasks.why_selected: Seeds and nuts provide healthy fats and prebiotic fibre for digestive wellness.

tasks.title: Include Beans or Lentils
tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Weekly Movement Summary Check
tasks.instruction: Review your weekly physical activity and aim for a gentle 20-minute stroll.
tasks.suggestion: Check if you reached your weekly movement goals.
tasks.why_selected: Tracking consistency builds confidence in long-term habit formation.

tasks.instruction: Add a portion of legumes or pulses to your lunch or dinner.
tasks.suggestion: Lentil soup, chickpea salad, or black bean chilli.
tasks.why_selected: Legumes are exceptionally rich in soluble fibre that slows carbohydrate digestion.

tasks.title: Pre-Meal Water Glass
tasks.instruction: Drink a large glass of water 15 minutes before your main meals.
tasks.suggestion: Still water or sparkling water with a slice of lemon.
tasks.why_selected: Aids hydration and supports natural satiety cues.

tasks.title: Break Up Sitting Time
tasks.instruction: Stand up and walk for 2 minutes every hour during sitting periods.
tasks.suggestion: Set a gentle hourly reminder or stand during phone calls.
tasks.why_selected: Reducing uninterrupted sedentary time supports cardiovascular and metabolic health.

tasks.title: Weekly Movement Summary Check
tasks.instruction: Review your weekly physical activity and aim for a gentle 20-minute stroll.
tasks.suggestion: Check if you reached your weekly movement goals.
tasks.why_selected: Tracking consistency builds confidence in long-term habit formation.

tasks.title: Add One High-Fibre Whole Grain
tasks.instruction: Include a serving of whole grains in your breakfast or lunch.
tasks.suggestion: Rolled oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread, or quinoa.
tasks.why_selected: Whole grains provide natural dietary fibre to support metabolic health.

tasks.title: Eat One Serving of Fresh Fruit
tasks.instruction: Enjoy one piece of fresh fruit with edible skin as a snack or dessert.
tasks.suggestion: Apple with peel, fresh berries, or a pear.
tasks.why_selected: Whole fruits provide intact dietary fibre, antioxidants, and vitamins.

tasks.title: Swap One Refined Snack
tasks.instruction: Replace one processed or sugary snack with a wholesome alternative.
tasks.suggestion: Handful of almonds or sliced cucumber instead of biscuits or crisps.
tasks.why_selected: Prevents rapid glucose fluctuations and trims unnecessary calories.

tasks.title: Restorative Sleep Routine
tasks.instruction: Begin winding down 30 minutes before bed and dim electronic screens.
tasks.suggestion: Aim for 7–8 hours of restful sleep in a dark, quiet room.
tasks.why_selected: Quality sleep regulates hunger hormones and improves daytime insulin sensitivity.
